blocks.text: O'zbek tilida «Qaysi ko'ylakni olasiz? — **Ko'kini**.» deymiz: sifatga `-i` / `-si` qo'shiladi (kattasi, yangisi, ko'ki) va ot takrorlanmaydi. Ingliz tilida sifat o'zi yolg'iz otning o'rnini bosa olmaydi: «the blue» deyish xato. Otni qaytarmaslik uchun uning o'rniga **one** (birlikda) yoki **ones** (ko'plikda) qo'yiladi: the blue **one** — ko'ki, the blue **ones** — ko'klari.

Yolg'iz **one** «a/an + ot» o'rnida keladi, ya'ni «shunaqa narsadan bitta» degani: I need a pen. Have you got **one**? (one = a pen). Bunda oldiga `a` qo'yilmaydi: «a one» deyilmaydi. O'zbekchada bunday gapda ot ko'pincha umuman tushib qoladi yoki «bitta» deyiladi: Sizda **bitta** bormi?

items.text: Is there a cash machine near here? — Yes, there's **one** inside the station.
items.translation: Bu yaqinda bankomat bormi? — Ha, vokzal ichida **bittasi** bor.

items.text: I haven't got a ticket yet. I must buy **one** today.
items.translation: Hali chiptam yo'q. Bugun **bitta** olishim kerak.

blocks.text: Sifat bo'lsa, u **one** dan oldin turadi. Har qanday bittasi haqida — **a** + sifat + **one** (a new one — yangisi, a cheap one — arzoni). Aniq bittasi haqida — **the** + sifat + **one** (the red one — qizili). **the one** dan keyin joy yoki belgi ham kelishi mumkin: **the one** on the left (chapdagisi), **the one** with a garden (bog'lisi), **the one** in the photo (suratdagisi).

items.text: This towel is wet. Can I have a dry **one**?
We bought **the** cheap **one** because we didn't have much money.
items.translation: Pulimiz ko'p emasdi, shuning uchun **arzonini** oldik.

items.text: Your coat is **the one** behind the door.

blocks.text: this one, that one, Which one?

Tanlash paytida ko'pincha **this one** (mana bunisi), **that one** (anavinisi) va **Which one?** (qaysi biri?) eshitiladi. Ko'rsatish so'zlari haqida → 74-dars, Which savoli haqida → 47-dars. Ko'plikda **these** / **those** ko'pincha **ones** siz ishlatiladi: I like **these**. **these ones** so'zlashuvda uchraydi, lekin yozuvda kamroq.

Bir nechta narsa haqida **ones** ishlatiladi: the red **ones** (qizillari), new **ones** (yangilari), **the ones** on the table (stoldagilari), **Which ones**? (qaysilari?). Lekin sifat yoki aniqlovchisiz yolg'iz «ones» deyilmaydi: «I've got ones» emas.

items.text: These grapes are sour. I prefer **the** black **ones**.
items.translation: Bu uzum nordon ekan. Menga **qoralari** ko'proq yoqadi.

items.text: **Which ones** are your keys? — The ones on the red ring.
Old houses are often cold in winter, but new **ones** are usually warm.
items.translation: Eski uylar qishda ko'pincha sovuq bo'ladi, **yangilari** esa odatda issiq.

blocks.text: one yoki it? ones yoki them?

**one** — shu turdagi **har qanday** bitta narsa (a ...). **it** — gap borayotgan **aynan o'sha** narsa (the ..., my ...). Ko'plikda xuddi shunday: **ones** — har qanday, **them** — aynan o'shalar. O'zbekchada bu farq «bittasi / yangisi» va «uni» so'zlarida ko'rinadi.

rows: I've lost my key. I need a new **one**.
I've lost my key. Have you seen **it**?
My shoes are old. I need new **ones**.
My shoes are dirty. I must clean **them**.
aynan shu tuflilar — ularni tozalashim kerak

items: **sanalmaydigan otlar** bilan (67–68-darslar): Black coffee or white? — **White**, please. («white one» emas);
**egalik olmoshi** o'rnida odatda **mine**, **yours** ishlatiladi: Is this your bag? — No, **mine** is the black one. (61-dars);
sifatsiz ko'plikda: «I've got ones» emas — I've got **some** (76-dars).

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I want the red.» → **I want the red one.** (o'zbekcha «qizilini» dagi `-i` inglizchada **one**); «Have you got a one?» → **Have you got one?**; «I like the new ones shoes» → **I like the new ones.** yoki **the new shoes**; «I've lost my phone. I need to buy it.» → **I need to buy a new one.** (it — aynan yo'qolgan telefon).
Eslab qolish: o'zbekcha sifatga `-i` / `-si` / `-lari` qo'shsangiz (kattasi, yangilari) — inglizchada **one** / **ones** kerak: the big **one**, the new **ones**.

examples.title: **one** = a ...: Have you got **one**?
examples.description: Yolg'iz **one** a/an + ot o'rnida keladi, otni takrorlamaslik uchun: I need a pen. Have you got **one**? (one = a pen). «a one» deyilmaydi.

sentences.text: I need a pen. Have you got **one**?
sentences.translation: Menga ruchka kerak. Sizda **bitta** bormi?

sentences.text: Is there a pharmacy near here? — Yes, there's **one** on the next street.
sentences.translation: Bu yaqinda dorixona bormi? — Ha, keyingi ko'chada **bittasi** bor.

sentences.text: Tom hasn't got a car, but he wants to buy **one** next year.
sentences.translation: Tomning mashinasi yo'q, lekin kelasi yili **bitta** sotib olmoqchi.

sentences.text: These sandwiches are delicious. Can I have another **one**?
sentences.translation: Bu sendvichlar juda mazali. Yana **bitta** olsam bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: Madina wanted a cat for years, and finally her parents got her **one**.
sentences.translation: Madina yillar davomida mushuk orzu qilardi, nihoyat ota-onasi unga **bitta** olib berishdi.

sentences.text: Do you need an umbrella? I can lend you **one**.
sentences.translation: Soyabon kerakmi? Sizga **bittasini** berib turishim mumkin.

sentences.text: There are bananas in the kitchen if you want **one**.
sentences.translation: Oshxonada banan bor, xohlasangiz **bitta** oling.

sentences.text: I've never had a pet, but I'd love **one**.
sentences.translation: Hech qachon uy hayvonim bo'lmagan, lekin **bitta** bo'lishini juda xohlardim.

sentences.text: We haven't got a dishwasher. Do you think we should buy **one**?
sentences.translation: Bizda idish yuvish mashinasi yo'q. Sizningcha, **bitta** olishimiz kerakmi?

sentences.text: Bekzod asked for a receipt, but the shop assistant didn't give him **one**.
sentences.translation: Bekzod chek so'radi, lekin sotuvchi unga chek **bermadi**.

examples.title: **a** + adjective + **one**: a new one, a small one
examples.description: Har qanday bittasi haqida sifat bilan: **a** + sifat + **one** (a new one — yangisi, a clean one — tozasi). Sifat yolg'iz qolmaydi: «a new» emas, **a new one**.

sentences.text: My phone is broken, so I need a new **one**.
sentences.translation: Telefonim buzildi, shuning uchun menga **yangisi** kerak.

sentences.text: This room is very noisy. Have you got a quiet **one**?
sentences.translation: Bu xona juda shovqinli. **Tinchroq xonangiz** bormi?

sentences.text: Our flat is an old **one**, but it's warm and comfortable.
sentences.translation: Kvartiramiz **eski**, lekin issiq va qulay.

sentences.text: I don't want a big car — a small **one** is fine for the city.
sentences.translation: Menga katta mashina kerak emas — shahar uchun **kichkinasi** ham bo'laveradi.

sentences.text: Sarah's bike was stolen, so she bought a second-hand **one**.
sentences.translation: Saraning velosipedini o'g'irlab ketishdi, shuning uchun u **ishlatilganini** sotib oldi.

sentences.text: What a lovely dress! Is it a new **one**?
sentences.translation: Qanday chiroyli ko'ylak! **Yangi**mi?

sentences.text: James told a joke, but it wasn't a very funny **one**.
sentences.translation: Jeyms latifa aytdi, lekin u unchalik **kulgili** emas edi.

sentences.text: We've got an old TV in the bedroom and a modern **one** in the living room.
sentences.translation: Yotoqxonada eski televizorimiz, mehmonxonada esa **zamonaviysi** bor.

sentences.text: Excuse me, this cup is dirty. Could I have a clean **one**?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu piyola kir. **Tozasini** bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: Dilnoza wanted a white dress for the wedding, but she couldn't find a cheap **one**.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza to'y uchun oq ko'ylak olmoqchi edi, lekin **arzonini** topa olmadi.

examples.title: **the** ... **one**: the red one, the one on the left
examples.description: Aniq bittasi haqida: **the** + sifat + **one** (the grey one — kul rangi) yoki **the one** + joy / belgi (the one in the blue dress — ko'k ko'ylakdagisi).

sentences.text: I don't like the black jacket. I prefer **the** grey **one**.
sentences.translation: Qora kurtka menga yoqmadi. **Kul rangi** ko'proq yoqadi.

sentences.text: Our house is **the one** with the green door.
sentences.translation: Bizning uy — **yashil eshiklisi**.

sentences.text: Take **the** big **one** — I'm not very hungry.
sentences.translation: **Kattasini** oling — men unchalik och emasman.

sentences.text: My sister is **the one** in the blue dress.
sentences.translation: Opam — **ko'k ko'ylakdagisi**.

sentences.text: Excuse me, is this the train to Oxford? — No, it's **the one** on platform 4.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, Oksfordga boradigan poyezd shumi? — Yo'q, **to'rtinchi platformadagisi**.

sentences.text: The first exam was easy, but **the** second **one** was really difficult.
sentences.translation: Birinchi imtihon oson edi, **ikkinchisi** esa juda qiyin bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Bekzod lives in the tall building — **the one** next to the park.
sentences.translation: Bekzod baland binoda yashaydi — **park yonidagisida**.

sentences.text: Aziz has two cousins, and **the one** in London works in a bank.
sentences.translation: Azizning ikkita amakivachchasi bor, **Londondagisi** bankda ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Don't use that knife — use **the** sharp **one** in the drawer.
sentences.translation: U pichoqni ishlatmang — tortmadagi **o'tkirini** oling.

sentences.text: There are three cafés in our street, but we always go to **the one** opposite the cinema.
sentences.translation: Ko'chamizda uchta kafe bor, lekin biz doim **kinoteatr qarshisidagisiga** boramiz.

examples.title: **this one**, **that one** and **Which one?**
examples.description: Tanlash paytida: **this one** (mana bunisi), **that one** (anavinisi), **Which one?** (qaysi biri?). Javobda otni takrorlash shart emas.

sentences.text: What kind of cake would you like? — **This one**, with the strawberries.
sentences.translation: Qanaqa tort olasiz? — **Mana bunisini**, qulupnaylisini.

sentences.text: I can't decide. Do you prefer **this one** or **that one**?
sentences.translation: Tanlay olmayapman. Sizga **bunisi** ko'proq yoqadimi yoki **anavinisi**?

sentences.text: Can you pass me that cup? — **Which one**? There are three on the table.
sentences.translation: Anavi piyolani uzatib yuborasizmi? — **Qaysi birini**? Stolda uchta piyola bor.

sentences.text: **Which one** is your brother — the tall one or **the one** with glasses?
sentences.translation: Akangiz **qaysi biri** — baland bo'ylisimi yoki **ko'zoynaklisi**mi?

sentences.text: This phone is nice, but **that one** has got two cameras.
sentences.translation: Bu telefon yaxshi, lekin **anavinisida** ikkita kamera bor.

sentences.text: Look at the map: we didn't stay in that hotel, we stayed in **this one**, by the river.
sentences.translation: Xaritaga qarang: biz anavi mehmonxonada emas, daryo bo'yidagi **mana bunisida** turdik.

sentences.text: **Which one** of these flats did you choose in the end?
sentences.translation: Oxir-oqibat bu kvartiralarning **qaysi birini** tanladingiz?

sentences.text: Madina tried on five dresses and bought **that one** in the window.
sentences.translation: Madina beshta ko'ylakni kiyib ko'rdi va vitrinadagi **anavinisini** sotib oldi.

sentences.text: There are two roads to Samarkand. **Which one** do you usually take?
sentences.translation: Samarqandga ikkita yo'l bor. Siz odatda **qaysi biridan** borasiz?

sentences.text: Is this your key, or is it **that one** on the shelf?
sentences.translation: Kalitingiz shumi yoki javondagi **anavinisimi**?

examples.title: Plural **ones**: the black ones, Which ones?
examples.description: Ko'plikda **ones**: the black **ones** (qoralari), new **ones** (yangilari), **the ones** on the shelf (javondagilari), **Which ones**? (qaysilari?).

sentences.text: These boots hurt my feet. Can I try **the** black **ones**?
sentences.translation: Bu etiklar oyog'imni siqyapti. **Qoralarini** kiyib ko'rsam bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: My old glasses broke, so I had to buy **new ones**.
sentences.translation: Eski ko'zoynagim sinib qoldi, shuning uchun **yangisini** olishga majbur bo'ldim.

sentences.text: Which apples do you want? — **The** green **ones**, please.
sentences.translation: Qaysi olmalardan olasiz? — **Yashillaridan**, iltimos.

sentences.text: **Which ones** are your children? — The two boys on the swings.
sentences.translation: Bolalaringiz **qaysilari**? — Arg'imchoqdagi ikki bola.

sentences.text: These towels are wet. Where are **the** dry **ones**?
sentences.translation: Bu sochiqlar ho'l. **Quruqlari** qayerda?

sentences.text: The cheap tickets are sold out — only **the** expensive **ones** are left.
sentences.translation: Arzon chiptalar tugab qolgan — faqat **qimmatlari** qolgan.

sentences.text: Aziz collects old coins, especially **the ones** from the time of Amir Timur.
sentences.translation: Aziz eski tangalarni yig'adi, ayniqsa **Amir Temur davridagilarini**.

sentences.text: Emma loves her new trainers, but she still wears **the** old **ones** at home.
sentences.translation: Emma yangi krossovkalarini juda yaxshi ko'radi, lekin uyda baribir **eskilarini** kiyadi.

sentences.text: Please don't take those cups — **the ones** on the top shelf are for guests.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, anavi piyolalarni olmang — **yuqori javondagilari** mehmonlar uchun.

sentences.text: Are these your sunglasses, or are **the ones** on the table yours?
sentences.translation: Quyosh ko'zoynagingiz shumi yoki **stoldagisi** siznikimi?

examples.title: **one** or **it**? **ones** or **them**?
examples.description: **one** — shu turdagi har qanday bitta narsa (a ...), **it** — aynan o'sha narsa (the ..., my ...). Ko'plikda — **ones** (har qanday) va **them** (aynan o'shalar).

sentences.text: I've lost my umbrella. Have you seen **it**?
sentences.translation: Soyabonimni yo'qotib qo'ydim. **Uni** ko'rmadingizmi?

sentences.text: My umbrella is broken, so I need to buy a new **one**.
sentences.translation: Soyabonim buzildi, **yangisini** olishim kerak.

sentences.text: Bekzod has got a new car. Have you seen **it**?
sentences.translation: Bekzod yangi mashina oldi. **Uni** ko'rdingizmi?

sentences.text: That's a lovely scarf. Where can I buy **one**?
sentences.translation: Qanday chiroyli sharf. **Shunaqasini** qayerdan olsam bo'ladi?

sentences.text: I like your scarf. Where did you buy **it**?
sentences.translation: Sharfingiz menga yoqdi. **Uni** qayerdan oldingiz?

sentences.text: The children broke two glasses, so we bought two new **ones**.
sentences.translation: Bolalar ikkita stakanni sindirib qo'yishdi, shuning uchun ikkita **yangisini** oldik.

sentences.text: Your boots are wet — put **them** near the heater.
sentences.translation: Etiklaringiz ho'l — **ularni** isitgich yoniga qo'ying.

sentences.text: Is there a good café near here? We'd like to find **one**.
sentences.translation: Bu yaqinda yaxshi kafe bormi? **Biror kafe** topmoqchi edik.

sentences.text: Madina made a cake yesterday, and we ate **it** in one evening.
sentences.translation: Madina kecha tort pishirdi, biz **uni** bir oqshomda yeb tugatdik.

sentences.text: Do you need a dictionary? Take **this one** — I don't use **it** any more.
sentences.translation: Lug'at kerakmi? **Mana buni** oling — men **undan** endi foydalanmayman.

examples.title: In a clothes shop: **Which one** do you like?
examples.description: Do'kondagi suhbat: **this one / that one**, **the one** with ..., a + sifat + **one** va aynan tanlangan narsa uchun **it**.

sentences.text: — Hello, I need a warm jacket for my son. Have you got **one** in blue?
sentences.translation: — Assalomu alaykum, o'g'limga issiq kurtka kerak. **Ko'k rangdagisi** bormi?

sentences.text: — Yes, we've got two. Do you like **this one** or **that one**?
sentences.translation: — Ha, ikkitasi bor. Sizga **bunisi** yoqadimi yoki **anavinisi**?

sentences.text: — **The one** with the hood looks nice. How much is it?
sentences.translation: — **Kapyushonlisi** chiroyli ekan. Qancha turadi?

sentences.text: — That's **the** expensive **one**, I'm afraid. It's ninety pounds.
sentences.translation: — Afsuski, bu **qimmatbahosi**. To'qson funt.

sentences.text: — And what about **the one** without a hood?
sentences.translation: — **Kapyushonsizi**-chi?

sentences.text: — **That one** is sixty pounds, and it's very warm too.
sentences.translation: — **Unisi** oltmish funt, u ham juda issiq.

sentences.text: — Good. Can my son try **it** on? He's eleven.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi. O'g'lim **uni** kiyib ko'rsa bo'ladimi? U o'n bir yoshda.

sentences.text: — Of course. Here's a medium **one** for him.
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Mana unga **o'rtacha o'lchamlisi**.

sentences.text: — Perfect, it fits! We'll take **it**.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r, chaq keldi! **Shuni** olamiz.

sentences.text: — Great choice. Would you like gloves too? **The ones** by the door are half price.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi tanlov. Qo'lqop ham kerakmi? **Eshik yonidagilari** yarim narxda.

examples.title: Mixed practice: **one**, **ones**, **it**, **them**
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: **one / ones** (otni takrorlamaslik), **Which one?**, **the one** + joy va aynan o'sha narsa uchun **it**.

sentences.text: My old laptop was very slow, so I gave **it** to my nephew and bought a new **one**.
sentences.translation: Eski noutbukim juda sekin edi, shuning uchun **uni** jiyanimga berdim va **yangisini** oldim.

sentences.text: **Which one** do you want — the chicken sandwich or the cheese **one**?
sentences.translation: **Qaysi birini** xohlaysiz — tovuqli sendvichnimi yoki **pishloqlisini**mi?

sentences.text: Two buses go to the airport, but **the** red **one** doesn't stop in the centre.
sentences.translation: Aeroportga ikkita avtobus boradi, lekin **qizili** markazda to'xtamaydi.

sentences.text: These grapes are sour — let's buy **the ones** from Samarkand next time.
sentences.translation: Bu uzum nordon ekan — keyingi safar **Samarqandnikini** olaylik.

sentences.text: I bought this shirt yesterday, but there's a hole in it. Can I have a new **one**?
sentences.translation: Bu ko'ylakni kecha oldim, lekin unda teshik bor ekan. **Yangisini** bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: We need two more chairs. Can you bring **the ones** from the kitchen?
sentences.translation: Yana ikkita stul kerak. **Oshxonadagilarini** olib kela olasizmi?

sentences.text: Sarah has three cats, and **the** white **one** sleeps on her bed every night.
sentences.translation: Saraning uchta mushugi bor, **oqi** har kecha uning karavotida uxlaydi.

sentences.text: Is this your pen? — No, mine is **the one** with the blue cap.
sentences.translation: Bu sizning ruchkangizmi? — Yo'q, meniki — **ko'k qopqoqlisi**.

sentences.text: James doesn't watch new films — he only likes old **ones**.
sentences.translation: Jeyms yangi filmlarni ko'rmaydi — unga faqat **eskilari** yoqadi.

sentences.text: Are you cold? There are blankets in the cupboard — take a thick **one**.
sentences.translation: Sovqotyapsizmi? Shkafda adyollar bor — **qalinini** oling.
